personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect all 5 coins, gems, relics, keys and hearts, open every door, and finish the level with the exit and Finish button.
personas.style: Plays methodically with goto:x,y to each unexplored region, then walks the whole grid. Checks the HUD after each pickup and at the end, and confirms the time bonus on completion.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit, doors or items out of the intended order, e.g. dashing over gates, dashing into locked doors without keys, stepping on spikes, or reaching the exit with keys still unused.
personas.style: Tries dash-into-door, dash past closed gates, use on non-lever tiles, enters the exit early, and finishes with a dash so the exit triggers on a dash tile. Watches whether the game stays consistent.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break the game through timing: pause, restart, quit and press several keys during pickups, hits, timer expiry and completion.
personas.style: Sends combined tokens such as pause+left, down+right, esc+enter, click:btn-resume while paused, click:btn-restart during play, and rapid repeats. Spams wait during enemy contact and presses movement keys on the same tick as a dialog opens.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document sentence by sentence and confirm each stated rule literally (lives start at 3, dash shows Dash 5, enemies move every other tick, invulnerable counts 4 ticks, Enter activates the main button).
personas.style: Reads each rule, designs a short token sequence to test it, and records the observed value next to the documented one. Does not skip rules that look odd, since the document marks intended oddities as by design.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, timer, dash and item counters to their limits and verify every amount against the rules.
personas.style: Collects all relics and gems to push score high, takes spikes at low score to check the floor at 0, fills lives to 5 with hearts to check the +500 rule, lets the timer run to 0 to check the life loss and reset, and compares every HUD number with state.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Level complete, Game over, victory) and check what text is shown and which buttons are clickable.
personas.style: After each dialog appears, inspects ui entries for visibility, text and top status, clicks each visible button, and verifies no button is covered. Also checks HUD text during and after each dialog.

checks.rule: The player has between 0 and 5 lives (maximum 5).
Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
The timer is between 1 and 300 while the game is playing or paused.
Invulnerability counts down from at most 4 after a respawn.
The level has 5 coins; the coin count is between 0 and 5 and the total is 5.
The HUD Lives field always shows the current lives.
The HUD Keys field always shows the current keys.
The HUD Coins field shows Coins n/5 with the current coin count.
The HUD Score field shows the current score (checked while the score is under 1000 to avoid thousands separators).
The dash recharge is between 0 and 6, and it is ready exactly when it is 0.
The HUD dash field shows Dash ready at 0, otherwise Dash n with the ticks left.
A dash sets the recharge to 6, which drops to 5 at the end of that running tick (HUD shows Dash 5).
At most one move per tick: a step of one tile or a straight dash of up to two tiles.
checks.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

checks.rule: While the game is paused nothing moves: player, timer, dash recharge are frozen.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.clock == prev.state.clock

checks.rule: The player never stands on a wall or on a locked door.
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D'

checks.rule: A closed gate is solid: the player never stands on it while gateOpen is false.
Enemies patrol along a route and turn around at obstacles; they never stand on walls.
Enemies move one tile every other tick, so each enemy moves at most one tile per tick.
checks.expect: all(cur.state.enemies, e => abs(e.x - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).x) + abs(e.y - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).y) <= 1)

checks.rule: After losing a life you reappear at the start (1, 1).
You keep everything you have collected when you respawn, including keys picked up in the same tick.
Touching an enemy costs one life and no points; spikes are checked separately.
Enemies cannot hurt you during the respawn tick nor the next 4 ticks.
Spikes cost one life and 500 points, with the score floored at 0.
Items disappear when collected and never come back except on a restart; coins, gems and relics never decrease without a restart.
checks.expect: cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins && cur.state.gems >= prev.state.gems && cur.state.relics >= prev.state.relics

checks.rule: A heart gives +1 life up to 5 lives; with 5 lives a heart gives +500 score instead.
Restart level puts the level back to its starting state (score 0, 3 lives, all items back, timer 300) and the game is running again.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

checks.rule: Completing the level adds a time bonus of 10 points per tick left on the timer.
Dialogs freeze the game: after level completion or game over the player does not move.
At 0 lives the Game over dialog appears with a Retry button.
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Game over')) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-retry' && u.visible)

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins counter stuck at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After the dash picks up a coin, state reports coins=1 but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD lags the game state.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' right after the coin is collected.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: Pressing pause then clicking Restart level resets the values (score 0, lives 3, time 300), but mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu stays open.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its start and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', no pause menu).

verdicts.title: Frozen-state check fires while pause menu is open (false positive)
verdicts.observed: After pause and restart the game stays paused for 30 ticks. The pause menu is visible and Resume and Restart buttons are present, so the player can act. The underlying restart bug is the same as candidate 1.
verdicts.expected: The check should accept a state where a dialog or button is available to act on. The restart-not-resuming defect is already covered by candidate 1.

verdicts.title: Spike hit makes score jump to 65136 instead of dropping by 500
verdicts.observed: Score was 100. A dash over spikes cost a life, and the score became 65136 (about 100 - 500 wrapped as an unsigned 16-bit value) rather than being floored at 0.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0, so the score should be 0 after this hit.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-200) and wraps to 65236 after spikes
verdicts.observed: Spike hits set the score to 65236 (a wrapped value of -300), and later it shows -200 in the HUD, which is negative.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and the spikes penalty is floored at 0, so the score should stay at or above 0.

verdicts.title: Key-collected toast covers the pause menu Resume button
verdicts.observed: With the pause menu open, btn-resume reports top=false, meaning another element (the 'Key collected' toast) sits on top of it at its centre, so a click on Resume would not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable, so nothing (including toasts) may cover the Resume button.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After the dash-right at tick 2 collects a coin, state shows coins=1 and the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD stays stale on that value in the pause frame too.
verdicts.expected: Per section 8 the HUD always shows the current values, so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Spike hit drives score negative and wraps it to 65136
verdicts.observed: At tick 4 the player (score 100) lands on spikes. Score jumps to 65136 (a wrapped value of 100 - 500), then goes to -300 on the next tick. HUD shows 'Score -300'.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score floors at 0 and is never negative. The score should read 0 after the hit, never 65136 or -300.

verdicts.title: Level-complete Finish button covered by the time-bonus banner
verdicts.observed: At tick 41 the 'Level complete!' dialog is open and btn-next (Finish) reports top=false while bonus-banner 'Time bonus +2590' is visible. The banner sits on top of the button, so a click there does not reach Finish.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable. Nothing may cover Finish, so a click on it should reach the button and advance to the victory dialog.
